I posted the draft bullets in a thread reply to Sofia's message in #coastal-team. I haven't sent anything to June.

The bullets cover:
- The 16 Feb rename from Covey & Lark Retail to Pellow Home Living.
- Moss's 18 May digest, which says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- The shared "PHL" acronym with Pellucid Harbor Logistics.
- The rule the team uses to tell the two apart.
- A suggested ask for June: use the full account names in saved reports and filters.

On 17 Feb, Sofia said she'd relabel the saved retail view and Kwame said he'd fix the terminal view. I couldn't see whether either change was made, and the digest is five months old. I flagged in the post that she should check the report's current label before the note goes out.
